summary: Frontend E2E of user request #8 (SSO/Passkeys, Viva simulate webhook, Extended Marketplace 15 professions, PWA offline). All 8 required flows pass. Login works, /settings loads at 1920px & 390px (tabs wrap cleanly, no overlap), 15 template-apply buttons present, applying lawyer + gym succeeds with Greek toasts and creates series+products, re-applying lawyer is idempotent (0 new records), Viva simulate webhook records payment on unpaid invoice (invoice ΤΠ-0001 3.067,48€ became Εξοφλημένο), passkey login button on /login fails gracefully with WebAuthn error toast, passkeys-card on /account renders with add-passkey-btn + nickname input, no crashes anywhere, all regression pages (/invoices, /products, /expenses, /pos, /account, /invoices/new) return 200 with correct headings.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Προσθήκη passkey' in headless env, button stays in loading spinner state indefinitely with no error toast surfaced (WebAuthn API never resolves). The /login passkey button DOES surface a Greek/English error toast ('Resident credentials or empty allowCredentials lists are not supported at this time.'), so the account-side handler should mirror that pattern with a try/catch + timeout that shows a toast on failure.

issues: Unsupported metadata themeColor is configured in metadata export in /login. Next.js 15 requires themeColor to be moved to a viewport export instead. Not blocking but shows warning on every page render.

verified_working: /settings desktop 1920px: 12 tabs (Επιχείρηση, Τιμολόγηση, Εμφάνιση PDF, myDATA, ΑΑΔΕ Lookup, Σειρές, Πεδία & κανάλια, Χρήστες, Email, API & Webhooks, Λογιστική ΕΛΠ, Ιστορικό) all clickable ✓
/settings mobile 390px: tablist width 358 == scrollWidth 358, tabs wrap in rows without overlapping content ✓

ΑΑΔΕ Lookup tab: 15 template-apply-* buttons render (lawyer, doctor, engineer, eshop, hospitality, tutoring, gym, restaurant, freelancer, hairdresser, pharmacy, realestate, transport, accountant, photographer) ✓
Apply lawyer → toast 'Δημιουργήθηκαν 3 νέες εγγραφές' ✓; Products page shows Παράσταση σε ακροατήριο, Σύνταξη αγωγής/εξωδίκου, Ωριαία αμοιβή νομικής συμβουλευτικής ✓
Apply gym → toast 'Δημιουργήθηκαν 4 νέες εγγραφές' ✓; Products page shows Personal Training, Μηνιαία συνδρομή, Τρίμηνη συνδρομή, Ημερήσια επίσκεψη ✓
Re-apply lawyer → toast 'Δημιουργήθηκαν 0 νέες εγγραφές' — idempotent ✓
VivaStatusPanel: Demo badge, webhook URL data-testid=viva-webhook-url (https://.../api/webhooks/viva/<orgId>) visible, simulate-viva-webhook button works ✓
Simulate Viva webhook → toast 'Προσομοίωση επιτυχής: εξοφλήθηκε τιμολόγιο a1de5210 με 3067.48€ (ref SIM-...)', /invoices shows ΤΠ-0001 = Εξοφλημένο ✓
/login passkey-login-btn present, click → graceful error toast, no crash ✓
/account passkeys-card renders with add-passkey-btn + passkey-nickname input ✓ (WebAuthn cannot complete headless, but no crash)
Regression: /invoices (200), /products (200, 13 items), /expenses (200), /pos (200), /account (200), /invoices/new (200) all load without errors ✓
action_items: LOW: In src/components/account/passkeys-card.tsx, wrap the WebAuthn startRegistration() call in try/catch AND add a timeout/reject so a Greek error toast is surfaced if the browser cancels/times out. Currently the button gets stuck in the loading state in headless environments (and probably on desktops without a resident authenticator). The /login passkey button already handles this correctly — mirror that pattern.
LOW: Move themeColor from `export const metadata` to `export const viewport` in src/app/layout.tsx (Next.js 15 warning on every page).
critical_code_review_comments: Marketplace applyTemplate correctly deduplicates by unique constraints (0 new records on 2nd apply) — good.
Viva simulateVivaWebhook works in demo mode without merchant credentials — correct behavior per requirements.

passkeys-list data-testid is not present in DOM when list is empty; if the intent is to always render an empty-state container with data-testid=passkeys-list for testability, add it to the empty branch too. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of required flows pass; 1 low-severity UX issue on /account passkey button

seed_data_creation: Applied lawyer + gym marketplace templates on demo org — created ~7 new products and multiple series. Simulated Viva webhook marked invoice ΤΠ-0001 as paid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features of user request #8 are working end-to-end. The passkey add on /account is the only UX gap (spinner never resolves in headless when WebAuthn is unavailable — needs try/catch+toast). Demo data now has applied lawyer+gym templates and one extra paid invoice from Viva sim; if you re-run marketplace tests, expect the initial apply to return 'Δημιουργήθηκαν 0 νέες εγγραφές' (idempotent) rather than new counts.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions. The previously reported crash on /settings ('use server' export + Drizzle unknown columns) is fully resolved; TEMPLATES loaded from src/lib/marketplace/templates.ts and applyTemplate inserts complete without errors.
